body:
Hi Myrl,

I like what you have built at Loves Garage Doors, 129 reviews at 5 stars is no joke. So it is a shame your homepage lists service areas that do not exist around here: 'Westlake District', 'Southside Community', 'Riverfront Neighborhoods', 'North County Suburbs'. That is unedited template filler on a live site, and a few headings even show stray 'SVG Image' text.

A family business running since 2013 deserves better than placeholder copy.

So I redesigned the Loves homepage and attached it to this email as a PDF. The fake areas and the stray text are gone, your real Tempe and Scottsdale coverage is in, and your 5 star rating and 24/7 emergency service sit right at the top, where a customer with a stuck door will see them first.

I build websites for home service companies. Total Plumbing (totalplumbing.net) is one of mine, a Dallas plumbing company with a clean, fast site built for phone searches. Leal Roofing (leal-roofing.com) is another, real service areas, real reviews, nothing fake left in.

If you like it, I can build it out on lovesdoors.com. If not, keep the PDF, no hard feelings. Shout either way.

Best,
Hassan
name: Loves Garage Doors
subject: 🚪 Myrl, your site lists service areas that do not exist
